decisions.decision: Keep T-400 as the single WhatsApp ask, paired with T-337, and do not repeat it on T-033 or T-034. Meanwhile, finish everything else on T-033 against the vendor simulator: the 3 Day-output campaign definitions, the WhatsApp step that is added only when WhatsApp is connected, and the Day 1 dry run. Once the Tantra key (T-337) is saved, read the WhatsApp connector status through the Tantra API. If it already shows Connected, tick the first done_when item yourself and reduce the ask to the test number only. When Adi's number is noted here, create the 3 campaigns, run the Day 1 test send to the Adi test identity only, confirm email and WhatsApp arrive within 10 minutes with no duplicate on the next tick, then close T-400 and move T-033 to review.
decisions.why: Connecting WhatsApp is a QR scan on Adi's phone, and the test number is his personal number. A search of sessions and tasks, plus the file list in ~/.config/tantra, found no number and no record of WhatsApp connected (2026-10-11). The T-033 decision of 2026-10-10 split this ask out.

decisions.decision: Adi has connected WhatsApp (T-401 done, 2026-10-12). 1) Deploy commit 9787eef2: wrangler deploy revops-centre, then git push. 2) Use the saved key to GET Tantra's WhatsApp connector. If it shows Connected, tick done_when item 1 and log the account id. 3) Read the connected account's phone number, with country code. Per the T-401 note, that is the Adi test number. Write it as a note on T-400 and tick item 2. 4) In the GrowthClub Tantra workspace, create the 3 WhatsApp-only Day-output campaigns and import only the Adi test identity. Send the Day 1 test WhatsApp to that number only. Confirm it arrives within 10 minutes and the next tick sends no duplicate. 5) Close T-400 and T-401, ripple to T-033 and T-034, and run dryrun_day1.py --require-real. If Tantra rejects a send to the sender's own number, log the error and only then open one input task asking for a separate number.
